svg.text: (T4) PiWM-value -- a goal-conditioned V( z , g ) trained by hindsight relabelling
a NEW head on the codes
module: every later latent is a goal; the step count is the label
hindsight relabelling -- no reward, no extra data, no privileged state
V-bar = a frozen copy of V
V( z , g ) = MLP( [ z ; g ] )
y = -1 + gamma . max_a V-bar( P( z , a ) , g )
expectile: L_tau( d ) = | tau - 1[ d < 0 ] | . d2
